pain_points.statement: Finance is three weeks behind on invoicing due to inaccurate load data, tying up critical cash flow.
pain_points.source_excerpt: finance is 3 weeks behind on invoicing because the data never lines up.

desired_state.statement: An automated or streamlined invoicing reconciliation process that eliminates data detective work for finance.
desired_state.source_excerpt: invoicing is the bleeding wound. We need to fix that first.

success_criteria.statement: Reduce Days Sales Outstanding (DSO) from 3 weeks behind down to the industry standard of approximately 5 days.
success_criteria.source_excerpt: days-sales-outstanding, which should drop from where we are now back to industry standard, which is about five days.

success_criteria.statement: Execute Phase 1 within a fixed-fee budget range of $250,000 to $400,000 tied to milestone payments.
success_criteria.source_excerpt: I've earmarked $250,000 to $400,000 for Phase 1, depending on scope.

risks_unknowns.statement: The CFO is highly skeptical of external consultants due to a failed engagement with a vendor in 2023.
risks_unknowns.source_excerpt: Skeptical of consulting engagements; got burned by a previous vendor in 2023.

pain_points.statement: Systems are fragmented across a legacy Rails app, Salesforce, NetSuite, and an outdated driver mobile app with no automated integration.
pain_points.source_excerpt: So it's three systems for one assignment, and the dispatcher is the integration layer.

desired_state.statement: Stakeholders disagree on technical execution: Marcus wants a full 12-month rebuild of the custom Rails app, whereas Sarah requires incremental updates.
desired_state.source_excerpt: He's been pushing for that for a year... making the case for incremental change instead of a full rebuild.
desired_state.contradiction_note: CTO Marcus Patel advocates for a complete system rebuild of Routemaster, but VP Ops Sarah Chen opposes a full rebuild due to time constraints and demands incremental changes.

success_criteria.statement: Automate data sync between Routemaster, Salesforce, and driver interfaces to prevent manual data entry errors.
success_criteria.source_excerpt: dispatcher double-entry between Routemaster, Salesforce, and the driver app

risks_unknowns.statement: Tech integration from past acquisitions remains incomplete and no formal TMS vendor selection has been made yet.
risks_unknowns.source_excerpt: Tech integration from those acquisitions is incomplete.

risks_unknowns.statement: An upcoming federal ELD compliance deadline in November may impact data or system architecture requirements.
risks_unknowns.source_excerpt: There's an ELD compliance deadline in November — federal mandate update.

pain_points.statement: Dispatchers waste significant time manually duplicating load details across three separate systems for 60-90 loads per day.
pain_points.source_excerpt: Right now our average dispatcher takes about twelve minutes to fully process a load through all three systems.

pain_points.statement: The mobile driver app lacks messaging, photo capture, and issue flagging, driving 2-3 hours of phone calls per dispatcher daily.
pain_points.source_excerpt: Every dispatcher tells me they spend two to three hours a day on the phone with drivers because the app doesn't do what they need.

desired_state.statement: A consolidated dispatcher workflow and upgraded driver communication channel that reduces manual coordination.
desired_state.source_excerpt: Our dispatcher workflow is killing us. Too much manual entry between our custom dispatch tool and Salesforce

success_criteria.statement: Reduce average load processing time per dispatcher from 12 minutes to 8 minutes (a 30% reduction).
success_criteria.source_excerpt: If we can get that to eight minutes — call it a thirty percent reduction — that's a real productivity win

risks_unknowns.statement: Contracted drivers dislike the current mobile app and may resist adopting operational workflow updates.
risks_unknowns.source_excerpt: drivers hate the mobile app... ping the driver through our mobile app — which the driver may or may not see.

pain_points.statement: Rapid corporate growth of 40% via acquisitions is threatened by operational bottlenecks and lack of technology integration.
pain_points.source_excerpt: Northwind grew 40% in 2024 by acquiring two smaller brokerages. Tech integration from those acquisitions is incomplete.

desired_state.statement: Scale operational capacity to support revenue growth without needing proportional headcount growth in dispatch or finance.
desired_state.source_excerpt: it pays for itself in headcount we don't have to hire next year.

success_criteria.statement: Deploy a measurable pilot into production by the end of Q3 (September 30) to secure continued board/CFO funding.
success_criteria.source_excerpt: Rita — our CFO — agreed to the budget on the condition that we have something measurable in production by end of September.

risks_unknowns.statement: The project timeline is constrained by CFO funding rules demanding a Q3 delivery, conflicting with proposed multi-year IT plans.
risks_unknowns.source_excerpt: The rebuild is a 12-month project minimum and we don't have 12 months.
risks_unknowns.contradiction_note: CFO funding requires a working pilot by Sept 30 (Q3), directly conflicting with Marcus's proposed 12-month minimum project scope.
